label: Accumulating squared gradients
subgoals: Square each gradient before adding it.
Keep a running sum of the squares.
Use the square root of the sum in the denominator.

label: The first update
subgoals: Compute G_1 from the first gradient.
Multiply by the learning rate and subtract from the parameter.

label: Later updates and diminishing steps
subgoals: Update the accumulator with the new squared gradient.
Use the new square root in the denominator.
Compare the second step with the first.
